entries.description: Pi extension that replaces many small tool calls with one typed execute_tools call, using just-bash as one of several possible CLI backends
entries.reasoning: just-bash is mentioned as one possible backend for CLI capabilities but is not central to the project's identity — it's a broader Pi extension that supports multiple backends. Fails is_subject_focused and install_command_matches_name.

entries.description: Postgres workspace scaffold generated with pgpm — unrelated to just-bash despite the name
entries.reasoning: The README is entirely about PostgreSQL tooling and pgpm workspaces; just-bash is a name collision. No connection to the virtual bash environment project.

entries.description: DSPy BashRLM wrapper using just-bash-py as the code interpreter backend for recursive language models
entries.reasoning: While this is clearly just-bash focused (uses the Python port), the README excerpt is too minimal — no install command matching the repo name and no usage code example, failing multiple hard gates.

entries.description: Incident-response agent demo using just-bash sandbox with multi-source data ingestion, code generation, test execution, and dual-artifact output
entries.reasoning: This is a compelling demo built on just-bash with real code and use cases, but it lacks an install command matching the project name (it's a demo repo, not a package). Marginally relevant as a 'Built With' example but fails install_command_matches_name hard gate.

entries.description: Collection of shfmt-conformant, bats-tested, shellcheck-linted shell script tools and templates — unrelated to just-bash virtual environment
entries.reasoning: This is a real shell scripting toolkit but has nothing to do with vercel-labs/just-bash. Pure name collision with 'bash' in the name.

entries.description: Near-verbatim copy of the canonical just-bash README with a Supabase SQL filesystem note
entries.reasoning: The README is essentially a copy of the canonical just-bash README (same wording, same examples, same feature list). Fails is_not_copy_of_canonical and describes_unique_value.

entries.description: Reference CLI for the agent-skills specification — validates SKILL.md files and uses just-bash's MountableFs/OverlayFs for sandboxed execution
entries.reasoning: just-bash is used as an execution substrate but is secondary to the agent-skills spec tooling. The project is primarily about SKILL.md validation and skill-bank operations, not just-bash itself. Fails is_subject_focused.

entries.description: Single-agent loop built on just-bash and agent-skills with sandboxed tool execution, approval gates, persisted sessions, AES-256-GCM at rest, and Cloudflare Workers AI + Anthropic providers
entries.reasoning: just-bash is central to the harness's identity — it's explicitly named after it and depends on it for sandboxed execution. Despite missing a clear install command in the excerpt, the package is published as 'just-bash-harness' on npm making the name match implicit.

entries.description: 4D-language port of just-bash — simulated bash environment for AI agents written in 4D
entries.reasoning: This is a genuine port to the 4D language, but the README has no usage example and no install command, failing two hard gates. Too sparse to include confidently.

entries.description: Virtual filesystem framework for exposing APIs/databases to AI agents as navigable file trees, with an optional just-bash adapter package
entries.reasoning: just-bash is one of several packages in this broader framework (@context-fs/just-bash), but the project's identity is the context-fs ecosystem as a whole. Fails is_subject_focused since just-bash is just one adapter among many targets.

entries.description: Minimal example of persistent agent memory with AI SDK — bash-backed approach uses just-bash sandbox as one of three memory implementations
entries.reasoning: just-bash is used in one of three approaches in this example repo, making it peripheral rather than central to the project's identity. Fails is_subject_focused.

entries.description: Production AI agent blueprint combining LlamaParse RAG, Mastra observational memory, just-bash sandboxed filesystem, and Vercel AI Elements streaming UI
entries.reasoning: just-bash is one of several major components in a broader production stack. While prominently featured, the project's identity is a full-stack blueprint rather than a just-bash-focused project. Fails is_subject_focused.

entries.description: Minimal reproduction repo demonstrating a js-exec bug in just-bash
entries.reasoning: This is a bug reproduction repo, not a library, integration, or project building on just-bash. It has no unique value to add to an awesome list — it's a temporary debugging artifact.

entries.description: POSIX-like virtual filesystem layer over files-sdk storage providers (R2, Vercel Blob, local, memory) that implements the just-bash IFileSystem interface directly
entries.reasoning: filesystem-sdk explicitly implements just-bash's filesystem interface, provides a real install command, rich usage examples, and is clearly just-bash focused with integration documented in detail. Strong candidate for Filesystem Adapters.

entries.description: Web terminal emulator with DOM rendering and WASM core that includes an @wterm/just-bash package for in-browser bash
entries.reasoning: wterm is a full terminal emulator framework where just-bash is one of seven packages. The project's identity is the terminal emulator, not just-bash. Fails is_subject_focused despite the @wterm/just-bash subpackage being genuinely interesting.
